notes.title: “Gyutaro Character Pack” Launches Today!
notes.content:
The “Gyutaro Character Pack” is now available to purchase for [i]Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles[/i]! This pack adds Gyutaro, the Upper Rank 6 of the Twelve Kizuki, to the game’s Versus mode (both locally and online), along with a new set of unique Gyutaro profile photos and quotes.

Players can pick up the “Gyutaro Character Pack” on its own, or save with the [i]Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles[/i] Character Pass! By purchasing the Character Pass, players will instantly unlock and save on all 5 character packs that have been released for the game, which includes the:
[list]
[*] Tengen Uzui Character Pack
[*] Nezuko Kamado (Advanced Demon Form) Character Pack
[*] Tanjiro, Zenitsu, and Inosuke (Entertainment District) Character Pack
[*] Daki Character Pack
[*] Gyutaro Character Pack
[/list]
[previewyoutube=GGJF6gdjYiA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Tengen Uzui Joins the Playable Roster
notes.content:
[u][b]"Tengen Uzui Character Pack” now on sale[/b][/u]

Tengen Uzui, the Sound Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps who engaged in a fierce battle against demons in the [i]Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc[/i] anime, is now available to purchase as part of a character pack for [i]Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles[/i]! This pack includes Tengen Uzui as a playable character in Versus mode (both locally and online), along with a set of Tengen Uzui profile photos and quotes.

To commemorate the launch of the Tengen Uzui Character Pack, a free update is now available that adds a new stage – “Entertainment District” – which can be enjoyed in Versus mode.

[u][b]Unlock the Character Pass[/b][/u]

The [i]Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles[/i] Character Pass is also now available to buy! By picking up this bundle, players will unlock and save on 5 different character packs that are scheduled to be released by the end of December 2022.

These packs will be distributed periodically over 5 separate releases that will include:
[list][*]Tengen Uzui
[*]Nezuko Kamado (Advanced Demon Form)
[*]Tanjiro Kamado (Entertainment District)
[*]Zenitsu Agatsuma (Entertainment District)
[*]Inosuke Hashibira (Entertainment District)
[*]Daki
[*]Gyutaro[/list]
Each character pack also comes with their own profile photos and quotes.

[u][b]Kimetsu Academy Summer Uniforms[/b][/u]

Finally, the Kimetsu Academy Summer Uniforms, previously only available in the Nintendo Switch version of the game, are now available to buy on Steam. This set includes summer costumes for:
[list][*]Kimetsu Academy Tanjiro Kamado
[*]Kimetsu Academy Nezuko Kamado
[*]Kimetsu Academy Zenitsu Agatsuma
[*]Kimetsu Academy Inosuke Hashibira
[*]Kimetsu Academy Giyu Tomioka[/list]

[previewyoutube=qlGBrMFGZsE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: [v1.30] Balance Changes
notes.content:
Our latest update for Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles includes several balance changes made to the game. Please read the changelog below:

[u][b]Combat Changes[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Air Hop Adjustments[/b][list][*] Shortened homing attack/movement invulnerability window.[*] Lengthened wait time after landing.[/list][/list][list][*][b]Chase Dash Adjustments[/b][list]Can no longer be canceled with Quick Step when far from the opponent. (When near, it will behave as normal.)[/list][*][b]Throw Adjustments[/b][list][*]Increased damage of throw attack.[/list][/list]
[u][b]Character Changes[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Tanjiro Kamado / Academy Tanjiro[/b][list][*]Skill 2 (Second Form, Water Wheel): Delayed and reduced mobility/speed of attack hitbox.[/list][/list][list][*][b]Sakonji Urokodaki[/b][list][*]Skill 2 (Second Form, Water Wheel): Delayed attack hitbox and removed ability to cancel a long-press modified attack if it does not hit the opponent.[/list][/list][list][*][b]Nezuko Kamado / Academy Nezuko[/b][list][*]Support Skill 1 (Crazy Scratching) / Support Skill 2 (Heel Bash): Shortened combo window.[*]Support Skill 1 (Crazy Scratching): Reduced damage dealt to an opponent's guard.[*]These adjustments only apply when Nezuko attacks as a support character.[/list][*][b]Rui[/b][list][*]Skill 1 (Web Toss) / Skill 2 (Thread Dash): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.[/list][/list][list][*][b]Akaza[/b][list][*]Chase Dash: Increased base speed.[*]Skill 1 (Destructive Death: Air Type): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.[*]Skill 2 (Destructive Death: Disorder) / Skill 3 (Technique Development, Destructive Death: Compass Needle):  Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard and shortened skill cooldown.[*]Skill 3 (Technique Development, Destructive Death: Compass Needle): Increased damage and lengthened combo window.[*]Demon Skill 2 (Destructive Death: Annihilation Type): Increased damage and shortened combo window.[/list][/list][list][*][b]Yahaba[/b][list][*]Demon Skill 2 (Blood Demon Art: Kouketsu Arrow, Eruption): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.[/list][*][b]Susamaru[/b][list][*]Skill 1 (Ball Kick) / Demon Skill 1 (Sixfold Temari): Increased damage dealt to both an opponent's guard and the opponent guarding.[*]Skill 2 (Spinning Throw): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.[*]Skill 3 (Piercing Kick): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard when the button is held down.[/list][/list]

tags.balance_change: Can no longer be canceled with Quick Step when far from the opponent.
Skill 2 (Second Form, Water Wheel): Delayed and reduced mobility/speed of attack hitbox.
Skill 2 (Second Form, Water Wheel): Delayed attack hitbox and removed ability to cancel a long-press modified attack if it does not hit the opponent.
Support Skill 1 (Crazy Scratching) / Support Skill 2 (Heel Bash): Shortened combo window.
Support Skill 1 (Crazy Scratching): Reduced damage dealt to an opponent's guard.
Skill 1 (Web Toss) / Skill 2 (Thread Dash): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.
Skill 1 (Destructive Death: Air Type): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.
Skill 2 (Destructive Death: Disorder) / Skill 3 (Technique Development, Destructive Death: Compass Needle): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard and shortened skill cooldown.
Skill 3 (Technique Development, Destructive Death: Compass Needle): Increased damage and lengthened combo window.
Demon Skill 2 (Destructive Death: Annihilation Type): Increased damage and shortened combo window.
Demon Skill 2 (Blood Demon Art: Kouketsu Arrow, Eruption): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.
Skill 1 (Ball Kick) / Demon Skill 1 (Sixfold Temari): Increased damage dealt to both an opponent's guard and the opponent guarding.
Skill 2 (Spinning Throw): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard.
Skill 3 (Piercing Kick): Increased damage dealt to an opponent's guard when the button is held down.
